name: Waldorf Astoria Seychelles Platte Island
insider_take: Paradise redefined on a private coral island where luxury meets untouched nature in the heart of the Indian Ocean.
whats_special: This ultra-exclusive resort occupies an entire 200-hectare private island, making it one of the most remote luxury destinations in the world. Platte Island is a protected nature sanctuary home to over 5,000 giant Aldabra tortoises - some over 100 years old - creating an extraordinary wildlife experience found nowhere else on Earth.
pro_tip: Book the villa with the private beach access - you'll literally have your own stretch of pristine white sand where sea turtles nest seasonally, and the house reef is just steps away for world-class snorkeling.
dont_miss: The sunrise tortoise walk at dawn when these gentle giants are most active, and the exceptional diving at nearby coral walls where you'll encounter whale sharks, manta rays, and pristine coral gardens in crystal-clear 30-meter visibility waters.
pros: Ultra-exclusive private island experience with pristine beaches
World-class luxury amenities and personalized service
Exceptional marine conservation and wildlife experiences
All-inclusive luxury with premium dining and activities
